name: Capture defects and quality inspections and close them out with trades
summary: Captures each defect as it is found on a job, keeps the trade chased until it is fixed, and asks the client to sign off once every defect on the job is closed. Crons read and draft; every reminder and client email waits for a person to approve it.

defects-on-jobs.evidence: 6 of 15 construction discovery calls that discuss defects describe how they handle them

covered_by.log-defect: log-defects (a defect checklist section becomes a register entry and a task on the job)
covered_by.chase-trade: chase (reminder to the trade, approval before it sends)
covered_by.rectify: chase (fixed status read back from the job checklist)
covered_by.close-out: close-out (sign-off task and client email, approval before it sends)
covered_by.record-keeping: register in the workflow store, plus a task per defect in ServiceM8

crons.name: log-defects
crons.summary: Record new defect items from each open job's defect checklist, one task per defect on the job.

crons.name: chase
crons.summary: Read which defects are fixed, and queue a reminder to the trade for each open defect that is due (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: close-out
crons.summary: When every defect on a job is fixed, draft an internal sign-off task and queue the client's sign-off email.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads, a task on a job for staff, and the register in the workflow store. Anything that emails a trade or a client waits for a person.

servicem8.covers: defect checklist section read, one task per defect, trade reminders and client sign-off emails through the approval queue

gaps: Procore is the most-named defect platform in the platform evidence (punch lists), but the kit has no Procore platform and no mapped operations for it. Its punch list is not wired. Map Procore's API first, then add an adapter.

ServiceM8 has no defect, snag or inspection object. Defects are read from a job checklist section named in settings (defect_section). A business that keeps defects in a spreadsheet, Dashpivot or a defect sheet needs its own adapter.
Backcharging a trade for rework or delay, pass or fail re-inspection, and booking a trade to attend or quote a fix are not covered. The ServiceM8 docs describe none of them.
Defect quotes and the pricing of small defects (the pain that quotes are not followed up) are a judgment step. Nothing here prices a defect.
A client walkthrough of a defects list is not covered.
Fieldwire is mapped in the kit, but no call or platform evidence named it for this job, so it is not built here.
Trade replies are not read. The chase sends reminders only; it does not parse what the trade says back.
The defect register lives in the workflow store, not in a spreadsheet the owner already uses. Export it if the owner wants it in Excel.
The adapter is docs-only until a ServiceM8 trial account proves the checklist read, the task write and the approved send.

evidence.calls: 15 construction discovery calls read for defects, 6 describe the process; manual share 100 percent on log, rectify and close-out
evidence.platforms: ServiceM8 mapped from its help centre and official spec (checklists, tasks, job, contacts, email); Procore from its help centre only, with no API ops
